tickets.subject: Printer shows error 42 since this morning
tickets.description: Our office printer stopped printing and shows error 42. What can we do?

articles.title: Printer error 42
articles.body: Error 42 means the print spooler stopped. Open Services on the computer that shares the printer, restart the Print Spooler service, then print a test page. If the error comes back, reinstall the printer driver.

tickets.subject: VPN sign-in rejected
tickets.description: Since today the VPN client rejects my sign-in, although I type the right password.

articles.title: VPN sign-in fails
articles.body: When the VPN client rejects a sign-in with a correct password, the password has usually expired. Reset it in the self-service portal, wait five minutes for it to reach the VPN, then sign in again.
